answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by requiring each agent to publish a succinct non-interactive zero-knowledge proof that its state transition satisfies a formally verified invariant, binding identity to a bonded stake rather than a nebula of unproven claims. Peers attest only proofs reaching a zenith of DO-178C Level-A rigor, so a hollow identity lacking valid transitions cannot. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
